artifacts.title: A pocket guide to balcony astronomy
artifacts.content: Draw a compact guide to observing the moon and bright planets from my apartment balcony. Use my own sketches and notes, with one page for each object.

artifacts.title: My observing notebook
artifacts.content: The first booklet will pair hand-drawn sky maps with notes from my own evenings outside. Keep it small and personal, like a field notebook that fits in a coat pocket.

artifacts.title: One-night map test
artifacts.content: Three neighbors used the moon map during a single balcony viewing night and marked where the labels were hard to read. This was a one-night usability test; the booklet is still based on my own observations.

artifacts.title: A shared observation page
artifacts.content: Made one prototype page with my Mars sketch and short viewing notes from two neighbors. We are testing whether several observations fit on one page; nothing has been published as a group journal.

artifacts.title: Proposal for a seasonal sky almanac
artifacts.content: Proposed inviting residents to contribute short sky observations for a seasonal neighborhood almanac. This is a proposal only; no community issue has been assembled.
